objective: Make PAEOS institutional memory durable: the ScarStore used by SoftLoop (runtime/orchestrator/__init__.py, currently default-constructed in-memory) must persist scars to SQLite in the state directory, and ops/autonomous_run.py must inject the durable store. Implement a SqliteScarStore (new module runtime/scar_store.py) with the same interface as ScarStore (record/match), colocating its database with the ledger (e.g. <state_dir>/scars.db). Add tests proving a scar written in one process is matched in a fresh process. See backlog/research/RB-0026-durable-institutional-memory.md.
accept: A scar recorded via one SqliteScarStore instance is returned by match_scars on a new instance over the same path
ops/autonomous_run.py constructs the durable store when state_dir is set
